item.title: All Six Stanzas of Vande Mataram to be Sung Before National Anthem When Played Together: MHA Guidelines
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Union Home Ministry has issued an order that all six stanzas of the National Song Vande Mataram must be sung when the National Song and National Anthem Jan Gana Man are played together. item.title: PM to Inaugurate Guwahati–North Guwahati Bridge, Temporary IIM Guwahati Campus on Feb 14
item.description: GUWAHATI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Assam on February 14, during which he will inaugurate the Guwahati–North Guwahati bridge and attend a series of official programmes across the state. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma said the bridge will remain open to the public for walking and viewing until March 1-2, with vehicular traffic allowed from that date. item.description: GUWAHATI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will land on National Highway in Moran in Assam’s Dibrugarh district during his visit to the state on February 14, Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma said on Wednesday, February 11. item.title: India Ranked 91st in Corruption Index 2025, Scores Lower Than Global Average
item.description: GUWAHATI: India has been placed 91st out of 182 countries and territories in the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2025, released by Transparency International on February 10. item.title: US Revises India–US Trade Deal Factsheet After Cong Chief Kharge’s ‘PR-Wrapped Betrayal’ Remark
item.description: GUWAHATI: The United States has modified its official factsheet outlining the key provisions of the proposed India–US trade agreement, removing references to tariff cuts on certain agricultural products — including pulses — and softening language on India’s proposed purchases of American goods. The revisions have gained political traction in India, with Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge sharply criticising the Centre over the agreement.
